Voting & Drop Box Locations

Voting & Drop Box Locations

General Election: Tuesday, November 3, 2026

Every active registered voter in Utah County is mailed a ballot. You can return it by mail, use any drop box in the county, or vote in person at any vote center on Election Day—you are not limited to the one nearest your address. Mailed ballots must be postmarked by the day before Election Day, while ballots returned to a drop box must be deposited before 8 p.m. on Election Night. You can track your ballot through processing with BallotTrax.
